comparison.objective: Align mating flanges and install four pins.
comparison.physical_skill: Bring two interfaces into registration and perform multiple close-tolerance pin insertions without binding.
comparison.success_condition: Flanges aligned and all four pins correctly seated; incomplete or forced misalignment fails.
comparison.reason: Multi-hole registration and pin insertion are different from collar adjustment, recessed set-screw access, and impact commissioning. Shared alignment is only a generic primitive.
